title: airlock instrumentation config — the boot(config) project config (PRE-1.0, NOT frozen)
description: The project JSON config `boot(config)` (adapters/eds/index.js) consumes: which connectors to instrument (+ their ids/endpoints) and the top-level consent/payload governance. Modelled as the DISCRIMINATED UNION it is: each connector entry's `type` selects one of ga4 / pixel / helix-rum / alloy (oneOf on a `type` const), with a nested `vendor` (meta / linkedin / bing) under `pixel`, and helix-rum's governance-free shape (spec 022 exempts RUM from consent/denylist). PRE-1.0 — explicitly NOT frozen: the MVP6 real-site validation is meant to exercise this shape and the later 1.0 API pin freezes what settles (this is NOT one of architecture.md's five frozen contract surfaces yet). ALLOY COVERAGE (spec 033-02 + 033-03): Adobe/alloy is covered for BOTH the ANALYTICS vertical (a {type:"alloy"} entry boots alloy via bootAlloy through the Edge interact; the stock @adobe/alloy SDK bundle is ADOPTER-SUPPLIED via `bundleUrl`, ADR-0016 — airlock does NOT ship it) AND PERSONALIZATION / decisions-as-data (spec 033-03): the interact's `__view__` decisions fill a pre-reserved CWV-safe box via reserveSpace — declared with a single `__view__` `placements` entry (multi-scope is a named follow-on). So MVP6's named 'GA4 + Adobe/alloy' supported subset is covered for BOTH analytics and personalization. Reference schema only: `boot(config)`'s RUNTIME validation is a lightweight hand-rolled SUBSET (no ajv in the shipped bundle); ajv validates THIS schema in the contracts dev harness (npm run validate).

connectors.description: The connectors to instrument, in order. `boot(config)` boots each and returns a composite over them. `{type:"alloy"}` covers BOTH the analytics vertical (spec 033-02) and personalization (spec 033-03, via a `__view__` `placements` entry).

consent.description: ADR-0007 consent vector: purpose name -> state (e.g. {"analytics_storage":"granted","ad_storage":"denied"}). Applies to the CONSENT-GOVERNED connectors (GA4, pixels); helix-rum is EXEMPT (spec 022 — RUM is not consent-gated). An open taxonomy, so purpose names are unconstrained; values are strings resolved case-insensitively (granted/denied; anything else -> pending).

consentStrict.description: spec 017-03 AC3 — a strict / no-processing regime for the consent-governed connectors.

payloadDenylist.description: spec 019-01 (ADR-0012) — extra payload keys stripped before egress, merged with the always-on built-in default. Applies to consent-governed connectors; helix-rum is exempt.

connector.description: A single connector entry — a discriminated union on `type` (ga4 / pixel / helix-rum / alloy). alloy covers analytics (spec 033-02) AND personalization (spec 033-03, via `placements`).

ga4Connector.description: GA4 (analytics). Consent-governed; the top-level consent/consentStrict/payloadDenylist are threaded in. GA4's measurement_id/api_secret live in the collect endpoint URL, not as a config id.

endpoints.description: Optional collect endpoint(s); defaults to the placeholder GA4 MP collect URL.

ctx.description: Optional pre-sourced identity snapshot; when absent, sourced host-side from the _ga cookie (004-03).

pixelConnector.description: An ads/remarketing pixel. Consent-governed (ad_storage). Nested discrimination on `vendor` (meta / linkedin / bing), each requiring its own vendor id.

conversionId.description: Optional LinkedIn conversion id for the `lead` event.

helixRumConnector.description: helix-rum (RUM authority). GOVERNANCE-FREE shape (spec 022): NOT consent-gated, no payload denylist — the top-level consent/consentStrict/payloadDenylist do NOT gate or strip it, and it carries none of those fields itself.

alloyConnector.description: Adobe/alloy — ANALYTICS (spec 033-02) + PERSONALIZATION (spec 033-03): boots the stock @adobe/alloy Web SDK in airlock's classic chamber, egresses one Analytics pageView via the Edge interact, AND (033-03) delivers Target personalization as data — the interact's `__view__` decisions fill a pre-reserved CWV-safe box via reserveSpace (see `placements`). Requires `bundleUrl` AND a datastream id (`datastreamId`, or its `datastream`/`edgeConfigId` alias) — alloy configure() needs it AND it is the config-integrity tenant pin (spec 015 / ADR-0011: the `configId` the honest Edge interact carries; a re-tenant to an attacker org is HELD at the seam). The endpoint-ceiling pins the grounded interact FLOOR (016-02). Consent-governed (analytics_storage + personalization) — the top-level consent/consentStrict/payloadDenylist are threaded in (the strict seam gate: a denied OR pending governing purpose DROPS the WHOLE interact — so a personalization denial holds analytics too, the 020-02 all-or-nothing behavior). The stock SDK bundle is ADOPTER-SUPPLIED via `bundleUrl` (ADR-0016 — airlock does NOT ship it; same-origin byte-pinned recommended, cross-origin supported). Personalization is a SINGLE `__view__` placement this slice; multi-scope is a named follow-on.

bundleUrl.description: URL to the ADOPTER-SUPPLIED stock @adobe/alloy bundle the chamber importScripts (REQUIRED — ADR-0016; airlock does not ship it). Same-origin byte-pinned recommended; a cross-origin Adobe-CDN URL is supported with the stated integrity/CSP trade-off.

datastreamId.description: alloy configure() datastream id (the Edge config id).

context.description: alloy configure() context array (default [] — the chamber is headless, no ambient auto-collection).

placements.description: spec 033-03 — Target personalization placements (decisions-as-data → reserveSpace). This slice supports EXACTLY ONE `__view__` placement: alloy's interact requests the `__view__` scope by default (renderDecisions:false, no `decisionScopes` in the request), so a non-`__view__` scope would silently never populate and is REJECTED (both here — `scope` is `const:"__view__"` — and by the hand-rolled runtime validator). Each entry names a CWV-safe box airlock reserves BEFORE paint (loadEager, via reservePersonalization) and FILLS with the `__view__` decision's HTML via reserveSpace once the lazy interact returns it. Multi-scope personalization (wiring `decisionScopes` into the interact + a multi-placement host-side map) is a named follow-on (docs/refinement-todo.md).

scope.description: The personalization scope. ONLY `__view__` this slice (alloy's default decision scope); a non-`__view__` scope is a named follow-on and is rejected.

selector.description: CSS selector for the box to reserve + fill.

minHeight.description: Reserved box min-height (px) — sized before paint so the later fill causes no reflow (max-height/overflow:clip cap the box; 018-02).

prehide.description: Prehide the box content (visibility:hidden, still in flow) until fill or the reveal-backstop timeout (default true).

timeout.description: Prehide reveal-backstop timeout (ms) — a decision that never arrives still reveals the box.
